sloka: सान्त्व्यमाना तु रामेण मैथिली जनक आत्मजा ।वन वास निमित्ताय भर्तारम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-३०-१॥
transliteration: sāntvyamānā tu rāmeṇa maithilī janaka ātmajā ।vana vāsa nimittāya bhartāram idam abravīt ॥2-30-1॥

translations.english: In response to Rama's consolation with regard to her stay in the forest, the daughter of Janaka, Maithili (Sita) said:
